fictional_runtime_witness_helpers.scope: Fixture construction and live qualification orchestration; separate from production policy.

independent_analysis_and_tests.scope: Independent result/receipt/native-log reconstruction and its tests; not producer runtime.

inspect_upstream_python.scope: Full pinned upstream Inspect Python source, including unrelated providers/tools; excludes third-party dependencies/non-Python assets. Not a minimum equivalent port.

installed_product_python.scope: Full85-file installed project Python surface; includes unrelated therapeutic/study capabilities. Not the minimum comparator.

maintained_extension_tests.scope: Includes fixture utilities; physical lines are not independent test assertions.

measurement_acquisition_and_review_suppo.scope: Root measurement/qualification, dependency acquisition, rehearsal and review support, including preserved superseded helpers; not the maintained policy runtime.

new_policy_and_inspect_runtime.scope: Includes common archive/record utilities also used by the bare arms; not all Inspect-only overhead.

reused_independent_validator.scope: Full eight-file independent policy closure; not new Inspect integration.

reused_reference_adapters.scope: Standalone native-product adapter; includes unused materialization helpers, not a minimal runtime estimate.

shared_experiment_controller.scope: Shared three-arm supervision, preparation, measurement and sealing; not native Inspect policy.

limitations: Physical source surface is descriptive, not complexity, development time, maintenance cost or proof of simplicity.
The nonblank_lines_not_starting_hash field is a lexical proxy: it includes docstring text but excludes even docstring lines beginning with '#'; it is not a token-accurate code count.
Full installed products/upstream contain unrelated features; group totals cannot establish minimal functional equivalence.
The common parent reuses TETHER process supervision and its imports. This is not a TETHER-free executable stack.
Native runtime port omits full eight-specialist scheduling and positive review retries; retain this functionality difference.
